executiveSummary: Fresh Blends remained paused following the client’s request to revisit paid activity in October. The team confirmed the pause again on September 8, and the September 1 to 8 platform view shows the four selected Fresh Blends campaigns paused with no delivery recorded. Organic visibility work was discussed as a possible alternative, but no new scope or restart agreement is established.

work.title: Pause request recorded
work.detail: The account team recorded the client’s request to pause until October. That is the requested review point, not an approved restart date.
work.whyItMatters: Makes the operating status and the next timing decision clear.

work.title: Organic visibility option proposed
work.detail: The team discussed search and answer-engine optimization as an option during the paid pause. It remains a proposal; no client acceptance or completed organic production is established.
work.whyItMatters: Provides an option to review if the client wants a different scope.

work.title: Paused status reconfirmed
work.detail: The account lead confirmed ads had been paused for roughly five or six days. The platform read also shows the selected Fresh Blends campaigns paused. The precise switch-off timestamp was not independently reconstructed.
work.whyItMatters: Supports a current status report without estimating a launch or restart.

decisions.decision: Paid campaigns paused at client request, with October named as the review point.

nextSteps.title: Confirm timing and next scope
nextSteps.detail: Follow up with the client on the pause and whether October remains the intended review point.

nextSteps.title: Check Fresh Blends destination readiness
nextSteps.detail: Verify the correct brand-specific landing pages, current offers and tracking before any approved restart.

nextSteps.title: Review the optional organic scope
nextSteps.detail: Define deliverables and obtain a scope decision before treating SEO or answer-engine work as active.

caveats: Campaign status and the selected reporting-period totals do not establish the exact pause timestamp.
Shared-channel discussion is not used to transfer another brand’s website defects or performance into this report.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
headline: A clear pause. A considered next step.
